data:
The user wants to turn Wi-Fi on. I can see the current screen is the Internet settings page in the Settings app. I can see there's a Wi-Fi toggle switch that appears to be currently OFF (the switch is on the left side and appears gray/dark). I need to tap on this Wi-Fi toggle to turn it on.

Looking at the coordinates, the Wi-Fi toggle switch appears to be at approximately [583, 366, 678, 387] based on the layout. The switch itself is on the right side of the Wi-Fi row.

Since the task is to turn Wi-Fi on and I can see the Wi-Fi toggle is currently off, I should tap on it to enable Wi-Fi.
do(action="Tap", element=[630,383])
